style.backgroundSystem: deep botanical green #175B4B for hero, feature and trust screens; soft off-white #F1F3EF for infographic and spec screens; card white #FFFFFF for info cards

style.lightingSystem: soft even studio lighting with front-left key, gentle darker vignettes on green screens, soft contact shadows, no harsh speculars
style.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh organic gardening visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of deep botanical green #175B4B, soft off-white #F1F3EF, clean card white #FFFFFF and one fresh leaf-green accent #4CA155; soft even studio lighting with a front-left key, gentle vignettes and soft contact shadows; modern geometric sans-serif type, white text #FFFFFF on green and dark botanical green #1E3B33 on light; consistent rounded-rectangle info cards and solid leaf-green circular badges with thin guide lines; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable centered product presentation at a slight front 3/4 angle; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable centered product presentation at a slight front 3/4 angle; upright bag posture consistent across the set
style.surfaceSystem: matte deep-green panel and soft off-white matte board; tropical palm leaves as the recurring surface accent
style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif type; white text #FFFFFF on green, dark botanical green #1E3B33 on light
